reason: It's free, it's Google sign-in, and I don't have to hand over my Instagram, so I'd try it once to paste in the next sketchy DM I get. Free is fine for that. I wouldn't pay for Pro until someone actually sends me a paid invite.
objection: Cafés and salons here only offer barter. I don't believe they'll suddenly pay me plus a fee to Mitra on top. It could be one more app that promises paid deals and leaves me with an empty inbox.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real paid invites from places near me, with the rupee amount written down, before I put any effort into a media kit.
